title: FuriusHunters
description: Th best Manhunt Plugin for Minecraft Spigot/Paper
body:
FuriusHunters is a simple and fast Manhunt plugin for Minecraft servers running Spigot or Paper 1.21+.
It recreates the classic Manhunt gameplay where one Runner tries to beat the game while Hunters track them using an automatically updating compass.

The plugin focuses on simplicity, performance, and ease of use.
There is no complicated setup. Just install the plugin and start a Manhunt game within seconds.

Features
The plugin includes a fully working Manhunt system.
It is simple and beginner-friendly.
Hunters receive a compass that tracks the Runner in real time.
Spigot and Paper 1.21+ are fully supported.
The plugin is optimized to avoid lag and only tracks locations when needed.
Only essential commands are included to keep everything clean and easy.
It works across multiple worlds.
There are commands to reload the config and reset the current session.
The plugin is lightweight and stable.

Gameplay
Start a Manhunt game using the command /manhunt start
Stop the game using /manhunt stop

Add a Hunter with /hunter add <player>
Remove a Hunter with /hunter remove <player>

Add a Runner with /runner add <player>
Remove a Runner with /runner remove <player>

Hunters automatically receive a tracking compass when the game starts.
The game can be stopped or reset at any time.
There are no unnecessary features, only the classic Manhunt experience.

Made by Furiusfighter213
